description: Analyse de stationnarité des étiages dans le bassin Adour-Garonne is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bassin Adour Garonne. This data layer provides trends in the evolution of flow rates and annual flows at the top of the watershed over the period 1968-2020 through several hydrological indicators (QA, QMNA, VCN10, start date and center of the low) at 56 hydrometric stations in the Adour-Garonne Basin which are part of the reference network for the ... Coverage: Bassin Adour Garonne. The portal shows the English title as "Stationarity analysis of the lowlands in the Adour-Garonne basin" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Bassin Adour Garonne. Its keywords include debit, inlandwaters, tendance, france, sdage-2022-2027, hydrologie. The listing shows 2 download or service links in GPKG, SITE. The listing shows 2023-06-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
